chapter: Chicago radio, Whiteman and courting Mildred
title: NBC staff band; hearing Duke and Teddy Wilson
summary: As Whiteman's NBC musical director in Chicago employed him, he and Mildred heard Duke Ellington and Teddy Wilson; they later recognized Wilson in New York.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Well, listen, now Red, let's see ah -- well we've got you -- we - so now you're really with Paul, now --
Well, I'm at NBC --
You're at NBC, yeah.
Yes. And well you want to go on from there?
Yes.
Or do you want some side things?
Well, if you've got some interesting side things that you think would be good.
We were going out and hearing Duke, when they tell the band -- I would hear bands.
LIke when Duke played the Oriental and things like that?
No, that's when I was working at NBC. After I had left -- Paul put me in at NBC, then.
YEAH.
I was on the staff band then.
Why did he have jurisdiction over that or --
Yeah, he was like the --
He was the --
Musical director of NBC, in Chicago.
Yes, I see.
Like he was in New York for awhile.
Yes. I see.
Later, During the War I think he was considered the musical director of NBC in New York.
In New York, yeah.
So I heard, I don't know --
Yeah, right.
And then he did a concert at the Edgewater Beach on the Walk, a year or so later --
Yeah.
-- used to do concerts -- they called them Concerts by the Sea -- I think it was, do you remember those?
Yeah, I do.

I did a couple of those and so I would just go and I used to go over and pick up Mildred there, maybe some of us would go out to the Dells or someplace like that near -- to hear Duke or Tom Geroni or some of the bands that would come into Chicago.
Yeah, yeah.
And we'd go and hear -- maybe -- we'd go back and hear Teddy, with Jimmy Noone --
Oh, that's (unintelligible)
Yeah.
And Teddy.
But --
So Mildred knew Teddy right back to there?
Oh, that's --
Teddy was married to Irene then?
I don't know if he was married to Irene then, but I know --
Well, just about then, I think.
-- I know that we came to New York and were settled in Forest Hills --
Yeah.
And -- somebody said Benny Carter is opening uptown -- at Small's Paradise and we went up -- Mildred and I went up for the opening and he brought Teddy Wilson in from Chicago --
Yeah, yeah.
That's when we recognized him, then we invited him out and -- yes, he was married to Irene at that time, yes.
Yes, because Irene and Teddy were staying at Benny's house -- they were staying with Benny. Benny had brought them out and they were staying at his house then.
They were, yeah, cause I know they used to come at to Forest Hills quite a bit.
